description: SQL migrations and seed data: write migration 002 (full schema with RLS, UUID PKs, indexes, foreign keys for all user-owned tables) and migration 003 (idempotent seed data for subjects, topics, learning resources). These are independent of FEAT-001's Python changes — they are SQL files only. Depends on FEAT-001 being committed first only because the SQLAlchemy models in FEAT-001 define what tables must exist; the SQL must match those table structures.
steps: 1. CREATE backend/supabase/migrations/002_auth_and_rls.sql — complete migration that is safe to run on a fresh Supabase project or one that already has the 001 tables. Use CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS and ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS patterns for idempotency. Contents: (a) Enable pgcrypto extension if not already: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pgcrypto; (b) Alter existing assessment_records: ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS user_id uuid REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL; ADD INDEX if not exists on user_id. (c) Alter existing practice_attempts: ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS user_id uuid REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL; ADD INDEX. (d) CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.profiles (id uuid PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, display_name text, education_level text, preferred_subjects text[], created_at timestamptz DEFAULT now(), updated_at timestamptz DEFAULT now()); (e) CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.subjects (id serial PRIMARY KEY, name text NOT NULL UNIQUE, description text, created_at timestamptz DEFAULT now()); (f) CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.topics (id serial PRIMARY KEY, subject_id integer REFERENCES public.subjects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, name text NOT NULL, description text, difficulty text DEFAULT 'medium' CHECK(difficulty IN ('easy','medium','hard')), curriculum_tags text[], created_at timestamptz DEFAULT now(), UNIQUE(subject_id, name)); (g) CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.practice_sessions (id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, subject text NOT NULL, topic text NOT NULL, difficulty text DEFAULT 'medium', questions_json jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', status text DEFAULT 'active', created_at timestamptz DEFAULT now()); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS practice_sessions_user_idx ON public.practice_sessions(user_id); (h) CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.conversations (id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, title text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'New conversation', created_at timestamptz DEFAULT now(), updated_at timestamptz DEFAULT now()); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS conversations_user_idx ON public.conversations(user_id); (i) CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.messages (id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), conversation_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.conversations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, role text NOT NULL CHECK(role IN ('system','user','assistant')), content text NOT NULL, created_at timestamptz DEFAULT now()); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS messages_conversation_idx ON public.messages(conversation_id); (j) CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.learning_resources (id serial PRIMARY KEY, title text NOT NULL, description text, subject text NOT NULL, topic text, resource_type text DEFAULT 'article', url text, source_note text, created_at timestamptz DEFAULT now()); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS resources_subject_idx ON public.learning_resources(subject); (k) CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.topic_mastery (id serial PRIMARY KEY, user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, topic text NOT NULL, subject text NOT NULL, mastery_score numeric DEFAULT 0, confidence text DEFAULT 'low', evidence_count integer DEFAULT 0, last_updated timestamptz DEFAULT now(), UNIQUE(user_id, subject, topic)); (l) CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.csv_import_jobs (id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), user_id uuid REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, filename text, file_size_bytes bigint, status text DEFAULT 'pending', rows_accepted integer DEFAULT 0, rows_rejected integer DEFAULT 0, validation_errors jsonb DEFAULT '[]', created_at timestamptz DEFAULT now(), completed_at timestamptz); (m) ENABLE RLS on all user-owned tables: ALTER TABLE public.assessment_records ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; ALTER TABLE public.practice_attempts ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; ALTER TABLE public.practice_sessions ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; ALTER TABLE public.conversations ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; ALTER TABLE public.messages ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; ALTER TABLE public.profiles ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; ALTER TABLE public.topic_mastery ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; ALTER TABLE public.csv_import_jobs ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; (n) RLS POLICIES — use CREATE POLICY IF NOT EXISTS (Supabase supports this). For each user-owned table: SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE policy checking auth.uid() = user_id. For messages: check via subquery SELECT 1 FROM public.conversations c WHERE c.id = conversation_id AND c.user_id = auth.uid(). For subjects/topics/learning_resources: public SELECT only, no INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE for authenticated users. Example policy: CREATE POLICY IF NOT EXISTS 'Users can manage own assessments' ON public.assessment_records FOR ALL USING (auth.uid() = user_id) WITH CHECK (auth.uid() = user_id); Repeat for all tables. (o) subjects, topics, learning_resources get only: ALTER TABLE public.subjects ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; CREATE POLICY IF NOT EXISTS 'Public read subjects' ON public.subjects FOR SELECT USING (true);

2. CREATE backend/supabase/migrations/003_seed_data.sql — idempotent seed using INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING. Seeds: 5 subjects with INSERT INTO public.subjects (name, description) VALUES ... ON CONFLICT (name) DO NOTHING. Subjects: Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, Biology, Computer Science. Then insert topics per subject using a DO $$ block or CTEs to get subject ids: use WITH s AS (SELECT id, name FROM public.subjects) INSERT INTO public.topics (subject_id, name, description, difficulty) SELECT s.id, t.name, t.description, t.difficulty FROM s JOIN (VALUES ...) AS t(sname, name, description, difficulty) ON s.name = t.sname ON CONFLICT (subject_id, name) DO NOTHING. Topics: Physics: Projectile Motion, Newton's Laws, Thermodynamics, Waves; Chemistry: Chemical Bonding, Acid-Base Reactions, Periodic Table Trends, Organic Chemistry Basics; Mathematics: Quadratic Equations, Trigonometry, Calculus Basics, Probability; Biology: Cell Biology, Genetics Basics, Photosynthesis, Human Anatomy Intro; Computer Science: SQL Joins, Sorting Algorithms, Object-Oriented Programming, Data Structures. Learning resources (8 records): INSERT INTO public.learning_resources (title, description, subject, topic, resource_type, source_note) VALUES (...) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING. Use a unique index or just check via NOT EXISTS. Resources must have source_note='demo-seed' so they can be identified as non-production content. Example resources: 'Projectile Motion Fundamentals', 'Introduction to Newton\'s Laws', 'Chemical Bonding Explained', 'Quadratic Equations Practice', 'Cell Biology Overview', 'SQL Joins Tutorial', 'Sorting Algorithms Visual Guide', 'Genetics and DNA Basics'. No URLs (null) since no verified external links — just title/description/subject/topic/resource_type='article'/source_note='demo-seed'.
acceptance_criteria: Both SQL files are syntactically valid and can be run against a PostgreSQL 15+ / Supabase instance without errors
Running 003_seed_data.sql twice does not produce errors or duplicate rows
RLS is enabled on all user-owned tables
subjects, topics, learning_resources have public SELECT policy
practice_sessions.questions_json column is present with jsonb type
All tables have appropriate created_at timestamps
verification: Verify SQL syntax by running: Get-Content backend\supabase\migrations\002_auth_and_rls.sql | Select-String 'ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY' — should find 8+ matches
Verify seed idempotency by checking ON CONFLICT clauses: Get-Content backend\supabase\migrations\003_seed_data.sql | Select-String 'ON CONFLICT' — should find multiple matches
findings: COMPLETED. Both SQL files created at backend/supabase/migrations/. Key facts for later FEATs: (1) 002_auth_and_rls.sql enables RLS on 11 tables total (8 user-owned + subjects/topics/learning_resources). All 11 tables have explicit policies — no table is left open. (2) practice_sessions.questions_json is JSONB type (not TEXT) — the SQLAlchemy model uses Text/JSON string but the Supabase column is proper JSONB. (3) subjects/topics/learning_resources have only public SELECT policies (no INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE for clients). (4) messages RLS uses a subquery via conversations to enforce ownership transitively. (5) csv_import_jobs gets SELECT+INSERT policies only (no UPDATE/DELETE from client). (6) 003_seed_data.sql uses ON CONFLICT (name) DO NOTHING for subjects, ON CONFLICT (subject_id, name) DO NOTHING for topics, and NOT EXISTS guard for learning_resources (no unique constraint on title). Running it twice is safe. (7) All seed records have source_note='demo-seed' for easy identification. (8) No URLs in seed resources (url=NULL) — no broken links. (9) Verification: 12 ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY matches in 002 (≥8 required); 2 ON CONFLICT clauses in 003 plus NOT EXISTS guard (multiple matches required).
